shabad.source_english: Codes of Conduct and Other Panthic Sources

en.bdb: Without supplication one who commences a task,

verses.gurmukhi: ਭੇਟ ਕੀਏ ਬਿਨ ਕੁਛ ਮੁਖ ਪਾਵੈ। (੩੧)
verses.translit_en: bheT ke'ee bin kuchh mukh paavai| (31)

en.bdb: Prior to offering, puts something in the mouth.(31)
Abandoned belongings, one who takes away,

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਯਾ ਆਪਣੀ ਸੇਜ ਜੋ ਧਰੋ। (੩੨)
verses.translit_en: bin tirayaa aapanee sej jo dharo| (32)

en.bdb: And takes another's wife to the bed,(32)
One who does not serve an approaching guest,
He won't be honoured in the divine court.(33)

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੀਰਤਨ ਕਥਾ ਸਿਉਂ ਮਨ ਨਹੀਂ ਲਾਵੈ
verses.translit_en: keeratan kathaa siau(n) man nahee(n) laavai

en.bdb: If he does not listen to the explications and singing of hymns,
By back-biting and gambling, if he gains,

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਹਾਂ ਦੁੱਖ ਪਾਵੈ ਤਿਸ ਕੋ ਕਾਲ਼(੩੫)
verses.translit_en: mahaa(n) dhu'kh paavai tis ko kaalh(35)

en.bdb: He suffers greatly through the death.(35)

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਸੁਣੇ ਨਾ ਕਾਨ
verses.translit_en: gur kee ni(n)dhaa sune naa kaan

en.bdb: If he does not listen to the criticism of the Guru,
Honour him by offering a sword.(36)
